titel: A Quick Update from the Leviathan Team

faehigkeiten.grund: Auslieferung wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt (megaphone vergibt je Abruf eine request_event_id, megaphone haengt ein timetoken an, Adresse traegt eine session_id, kein ETag und Cache-Control "max-age=0, no-cache, no-store", Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst megaphone.fm) - Byte-Offsets veralten (bei dynamischer Auslieferung sofort, gemessen 19.08.2026) und die Zeitachse verschiebt sich mit (eine Folge war 57 s kuerzer als 3,5 h zuvor), deshalb sind auch Sprungmarken in Sekunden unsicher

einzeiler: A brief update on the upcoming content and future plans for the podcast feed.
kurzfassung: Kristoff announces that the podcast feed will become quieter while he works on the next major expansion called the Syraxian Cataclysm. During this hiatus, he will host weekly live writing sessions on Patreon starting this Friday. New episodes from the expanded universe are scheduled to premiere later this summer.
stichpunkte: The podcast achieved consistent weekly releases over the past year, including special editions and comedy skits.
The feed will quiet down temporarily as production begins on the next major expansion.
The upcoming project is titled the Syraxian Cataclysm, exploring the origin story of Elgar and Karana.
The story will feature an expansive, multi-planetary setting comparable in style to Dune and Game of Thrones.
First episodes from the new series are expected to launch later this summer.
Weekly live writing sessions for the new project will be hosted on Patreon starting this Friday.

clips.text: The creator expresses appreciation for the supportive community and looks forward to further interaction on Patreon.

beschreibung:
This is a brief update from the Leviathan Audio team.

After a full year of weekly releases, the feed will be a little quieter as we begin work on our next major story, The Soraxian Cataclysm, a sweeping new chapter exploring the origins of immortality.

We’re planning to release the first episodes later this summer. In the meantime, join us on Patreon for live writing sessions, updates, and behind-the-scenes content:
patreon.com/leviathanchronicles

Learn more about your ad choices. Visit megaphone.fm/adchoices
